stories.title: Shelton defends Montreal title — back-to-back Canadian Masters champion

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Ben Shelton defends the Canadian Masters 🏆

6-3, 7-6(4) over Nakashima. First since Nadal (2018-19) to back-to-back Canada. Joins Murray and Djokovic in Open Era history.

Playing through a bleeding elbow. Different. 🎾

#Tennis #ATP #CanadianOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Shelton entered Montreal 1-4 in Masters 1000 events this year.

He leaves as a two-time Canadian champion — without dropping a single set all week.

"One match can change everything." He proved it. 🎾

#ATP #BenShelton #NationalBankOpen

research.facts:
Shelton defends Montreal title
**Sources:** ATP Tour official, Tennis Majors, Sofascore, Perfect Tennis
**Key facts:**
- Ben Shelton def. Brandon Nakashima 6-3, 7-6(4) in Montreal ATP 1000 final
- Shelton did not drop a single set in the entire tournament (5 matches)
- Joins Andy Murray (2009-10), Novak Djokovic (2011-12), Rafael Nadal (2018-19) as only men in Open Era to defend Canadian Masters title
- First man since Nadal (2018-19) to successfully defend the Canadian Masters crown
- Shelton was 1-4 at Masters 1000 events in 2026 entering this tournament
- Quote: "One match can change everything" (ATP Tour)
- Shelton was injured mid-match yesterday (Aug 13 SF) — collided with LCD panel, bleeding elbow/hand — but recovered to win final
- Doubles final also won by Orlando Luz/Rafael Matos (BRA) — first Brazilian pair to win ATP Masters 1000 doubles title
**Confidence:** HIGH (ATP Tour official source + Tennis Majors + Sofascore)

Iga Swiatek wins Toronto 🏆

The No. 7 seed walked in and made it look effortless. She's back. 🎾

- Ends roughly 10-month title drought
- 12th career WTA 1000 title for Swiatek
- Swiatek described as dominant, dictating from the baseline throughout
- Completes "career sweep of the North American swing" (Tennis Majors)
- First 2026 WTA 1000 title/first WTA 1000 final of 2026 for Swiatek
**Confidence:** HIGH (WTA Tour official + Sofascore + AP wire)

Cincinnati Day 2

- Western & Southern Open 2026, Mason OH, Lindner Family Tennis Centre
- 125th men's edition
- Day 2 August 14: first-round matches for lower seeds/qualifiers
- Top seeds have byes: Zverev (No. 1), Djokovic (No. 3 seed, returning since Wimbledon) play August 15
- Djokovic vs. Thiago Agustin Tirante (August 15)
- Zverev vs. winner of Cameron Norrie/Dino Prizmic (August 15)
- WTA: Sabalenka (1), Rybakina (2), Swiatek (defending 2025) in field
- Notable Day 2 matches: Sebastian Baez vs. Grigor Dimitrov; Sara Bejlek vs. Karolina Pliskova
**Confidence:** MEDIUM (schedule sources, results still completing)

research.facts:
US Open tune-up context
**Sources:** ATP Tour, WTA Tour
**Key facts:**
- US Open 2026 begins August 30 (men's main draw August 30, final September 13)
- Cincinnati runs through August 23
- Alcaraz withdrew from Cincinnati (wrist/tenosynovitis, out since April 14 Barcelona)
- Sinner withdrew from Cincinnati (right knee); targeting US Open
- Swiatek Toronto title makes her the WTA frontrunner entering US Open
- Shelton enters with defending Montreal title and momentum
- Key players to watch: Djokovic (returning), Zverev (No. 1 seed), Shelton (2025 US Open finalist), Rybakina, Gauff
**Confidence:** HIGH for facts, MEDIUM for predictions
